body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0176 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "DNS query to tunneling / suspicious patterns - Behavior: DNS query to tunneling / suspicious patterns. Anchor after classic/XML coalesce. Not telemetry_validated."
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0176"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1071.004"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "22"
    $e.network.dns.questions.name = /^[a-z0-9]{25,}\.|dnscat|\.localtunnel\.|trycloudflare/ nocase

  condition:
    $e
}
